details: AP averages precision at true relevant ranks; INP is relevant-gallery count divided by last relevant rank; CMC is first relevant rank success. Dataset-valid query means are multiplied by 100 to report percentages.

No metric is divided by the model prediction maximum, minimum, mean or other prediction-derived scale. L2-normalizing descriptors before squared Euclidean distance is part of the retrieval metric, not score inflation.

Fresh stdlib aggregation of 1200 current/reused native/full CSVs produced maximum six-metric error 2.842170943040401e-14 percentage points; 147 baseline CSVs produced maximum error 1.4210854715202004e-14. CMC1..50 and current-model identity/camera/scene groups agree.
